reasons.plausibility: The mechanism and alloy concepts are not fundamentally wrong, but the mixture of different systems (Mo-doped composites and PtRuFeCoNi shells) with only partial coherence introduces notable gaps and confusion about the exact scientific basis.
reasons.testability: A series of proposed techniques (ECSA-normalized LSV, operando XAS, DFT, in situ STEM) could test the stated mechanism and outcome, making the hypothesis reasonably testable in principle despite its complexity.
reasons.usefulness: It deviates substantially from the stated context (ethanol oxidation on PtPdRhRuIrOs) and mixes multiple material systems, offering limited direct guidance to researchers specifically working on EOR with those catalysts.
